title: GitHub-first trading concept skill library
decision: Expose one repository router skill and keep each canonical concept as an individually installable, self-contained catalog skill outside automatic discovery.
rationale: Skills package reusable workflows; the concept JSON remains the factual source of truth.
Parameterized concepts use explicit inputs instead of duplicated skills for every numeric value.
A large discovery list can exceed host metadata budgets, so a router preserves reliable discovery while individual packages remain portable.
Generated concept references carry canonical hashes so package data cannot silently drift.

prohibited: claims of certainty or guaranteed profitability
presentation of educational analysis as personalized financial advice

catalog.build: deterministic full-catalog generation from canonical concept JSON
catalog.order: core-perps concepts by master_index, then all remaining concepts by master_index
catalog.count_policy: derive concept, skill, and alias counts from canonical files
catalog.compatibility_policy: retired numbered concepts resolve through parameter-bearing aliases and are not counted as canonical entries

sources.section: Progressive disclosure, skill anatomy, discovery locations, and best practices
MCP connects models to external tools and context

warning: Built with AI systems. Concept skills provide educational research and decision support, not financial advice, execution, or evidence of profitability.
